'''Murdoc''' is an officer in the [[Ever Victorious Army]].
== Activities ==
He is part of the ''[[Hailene]]'', and aids in the occupation of [[Toman Head]], where he serves under Lord [[Timak]], a low-ranking member of [[the Blood]].<ref name="RPG">''[[The Wheel of Time Roleplaying Game]]''</ref>
